name: py-incident-captures-reviewer-eval
setup: sed -i.bak 's/        if new_status not in TRANSITIONS\[claim.status\]:/        if False and new_status not in TRANSITIONS[claim.status]:/' src/claims/store.py && rm src/claims/store.py.bak && "$EVAL_DIR/fixtures/commit.sh" 'perf: skip transition lookup'
prompt: /sdlc-incident Since the last deploy, paid claims are being moved back to in_review (the audit found 12). Headless mode: diagnose read-only, then close the loop. The culprit is a merged commit, so also capture a reviewer eval for it. Do not fix the code.
allowed_tools: Read,Write,Edit,Grep,Glob,Bash(git log:*),Bash(git show:*),Bash(ls:*),Bash(sdlc ci capture-eval:*),Bash(.sdlc/bin/sdlc ci capture-eval:*)

checks.why: the commit that caused it becomes a reviewer eval
